dense.policy: Only selected TRAIN labels determine target std, normalized loss targets and their proof hashes. Cached omitted labels are loaded/integrity-checked but are not fitted or summarized. Development labels remain evaluation-only.

sparse.policy: Only selected TRAIN labels determine target std, normalized loss targets and their proof hashes. Cached omitted labels are loaded/integrity-checked but are not fitted or summarized. Development labels remain evaluation-only.

dense.sign_policy: Negative means lower interval error than pointwise. Signed descriptive paired differences only: no new success threshold, significance test or winner export.

sparse.sign_policy: Negative means lower interval error than pointwise. Signed descriptive paired differences only: no new success threshold, significance test or winner export.

inference.policy: CUDA-synchronized median direct normalized model evaluation; excludes transfers and physical postprocessing. Same architecture: measurement fluctuations are not architectural speedups.

cost_policy: 750 optimization steps andexact5nodes are matched, NOT FLOPs. All arms compute allthree penalty forwards; selected backward/JVP costs differ. Persisted seconds exclude calibration/evaluation/I/O/audit. Warm costs are previous reused work, not new fits. Allocated memory peaks are lastsegment only. Samearchitecture timing differences are not inference speedups.
limitations: One previously consumed development split, two supervision conditions, three model seeds and one fixed initial-gradientratio rule. Same-node coverage does not equal full objective/optimization tuning or identical effective regularization through training. Shared operator/metric replay and TRAINalgebra are not independent PDE accuracy or new confirmation. No module, architecture novelty, general integral superiority or selected deployable predictor established.
